summary: The iTop ticket integration faithfully implements the authoritative design across all hard requirements. The iTop network client is strictly read-only (SELECT / SELECT 1 only, every input bound as a ? placeholder, no multipleStatements, no DDL/DML), its run() enforces the whole-operation Promise.race deadline (acquire + query) rather than relying on the driver/pool timeouts (§5 Finding 1), and resolveContacts/resolveOrganizations pass WRAPPED [ids] with an empty-array guard before the call (§5 Finding 2). No secret is logged or returned anywhere: driver errors are normalized to a bare ItopUnreachableError, pingItop/pingN8n never attach ITOP_DATABASE_URL/N8N_API_KEY, and the error table maps to fixed safe messages. search/preview are auth-only (assertSameOrigin + requireAuthenticatedUser, no new RBAC), while both test endpoints require ADMINISTRATION_MANAGE (§7). changeTicket is required in both acl.schema.ts and route.schema.ts, and all four pages' buildPayload() send changeTicket: form.changeTicket with NO `|| undefined` and NO `as *Input` cast (the only `|| undefined` uses are on the optional mask fields), so the compile-time safety net is intact (§4.1/§14). Generate gating is `|| !form.changeTicket` on all four pages (§10.3). ItopTicketModal renders every iTop-sourced string via {{ }} with no v-html or raw-HTML sink (§10.2/R6), uses only ui-conventions tokens and the shared Loading/Empty/Error states, and does not restyle FormField. pingN8n treats HTTP >=500 as degraded (ok:false) (§8/R14). ITOP_DATABASE_URL is optional in EnvSchema and commented-out in .env.example so boot survives it being unset (R17). ITEMS_PER_PAGE=5 is confirmed in administration/index.vue, and the three specs were updated (§13). Verification is `npm run typecheck` + `npm run build`; both FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 findings record them run green by the user (per the AGENTS.md 'user runs all commands' model), and the structural conditions that would fail typecheck (the removed casts / changeTicket mismatch) are confirmed absent, imports resolve, and mysql2 3.15.3 is pinned and installed. No blocking findings.

findings.detail: pingItop() declares its return type inline as `Promise<{ ok: boolean, message: string }>` instead of importing the shared `ConnectionTestResult` type from #shared/schemas/itop.schema (which n8n-client.ts's pingN8n does use). The shape is structurally identical so there is no behavioral or type-safety issue, but using the shared alias would make the contract explicit and consistent across the two probes.
findings.fix: Import `ConnectionTestResult` from '#shared/schemas/itop.schema' and annotate `pingItop(): Promise<ConnectionTestResult>`, matching pingN8n in n8n-client.ts.

findings.detail: The `previewing` ref is set true/false in onPick but the preview LoadingState is rendered with `v-if="previewing"` while the results list and search states use a shared v-if/v-else-if chain above it; the two blocks are independent, so during a preview load both the (now-empty) results chain branch and the preview loader can be evaluated. This is cosmetic only (results list still shows while a preview loads, which is arguably desirable) and does not affect correctness or security.
findings.fix: Optional: if a cleaner single-focus modal body is desired, gate the results list with an additional `&& !detail && !previewing` so the list hides once a ticket is being previewed. Not required.
